entries.title: Ephesians 6:5
segments:
That according to the flesh are your masters. The coming of the kingdom of Christ did not work a revolution in the outward world, but it implanted the spirit of the brotherhood of man in which slavery could no more exist, and made the masters servants in Christ to their own slaves.
 

 
 With fear and trembling...as unto Christ. Whole-hearted and conscientious service sums up and embodies all the Christian graces.
